missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Восторг' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'был'. 'Полный' is the agreeing masculine adjective conveying complete delight.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Восторг' is an inanimate masculine noun, so its accusative equals the nominative. It is the direct object of 'вызвал', and 'общий' agrees in the masculine.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'предел'. 'Восторгу' is the dative governed by 'предел'. 'Моему' agrees in the masculine dative, expressing boundless delight.
Strategic focus: Genitive of cause. 'Восторга' takes the genitive after 'от', here marking the cause of the shouting. A natural way to express acting out of delight.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Восторге' is the prepositional form after 'в', describing the emotional state the audience was in. A common idiom for being delighted.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Восторгом' is the instrumental, showing what she radiated. The verb 'светилась' agrees in feminine gender with the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Восторга' takes the genitive after 'без', meaning the news was met without enthusiasm. A useful negative-emotion frame.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Восторгов' is the genitive plural governed by the short adjective 'полон', describing a film full of raptures. The plural counts repeated bursts of delight.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with genitive modifier. 'Восторг' is nominative as the subject, while 'детей' is the genitive plural showing whose delight it is. An impersonal predicate completes the thought.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Восторгом' takes the instrumental after 'с', forming an adverbial phrase that means accepting the gift with delight.
